DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_MATCH_VALID_IP_BINDING.desc: Configure the MATCH tables with multiple conditions and bindings sharing a condition while the interface remains in PORT mode.

DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_MATCH_VALID_RANGE_BINDI.desc: Configure the MATCH tables with a condition bound to a named range while the interface remains in PORT mode.

DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_MATCH_MAX_LENGTH_BOUNDA.desc: Accept 255-character match names, match values, and binding names.

DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_MATCH_TYPE_ABSENT.desc: Reject a match condition without a type.

DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_MATCH_VALUE_ABSENT.desc: Reject a match condition without a value.

DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_MATCH_TYPE_INVALID.desc: Reject an unsupported match condition type.

DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_BINDING_MATCHES_ABSENT.desc: Reject a binding without any match conditions.

DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_BINDING_NON_EXIST_MATCH.desc: Reject a binding that references a nonexistent match condition.

DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_BINDING_NON_EXIST_INTER.desc: Reject a binding that references a nonexistent DHCP interface.

DHCP_SERVER_IPV4_BINDING_BOTH_IPS_AND_RA.desc: Reject a binding with both direct IPs and named ranges.
